item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00300","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C20","C05","C13"],"selected_candidate_label":"C20","confidence":0.93,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C20 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. Both orders first assign an abolished or terminating entity's remaining functions, including liquidation or winding up, to a successor administrator; then transfer the associated records, property, and unexpended funds; place performance under specified direction and control; and conclude with an effective-date clause. C05 is substantively important because it created the same Federal Facilities Corporation and assigned it rubber-related functions, but its operative sequence is less similar to the child. C13 contains related defense-program transfer and liquidation machinery but is broader and less closely patterned.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"including the winding up of the affairs of the Commission","parent_excerpt":"relating to the liquidation of the Small Defense Plants Administration, including... all remaining functions, powers, and duties","explanation":"Both assign the remaining business of a terminating agency, expressly including its liquidation or winding up, to a successor."},{"child_excerpt":"The records, property, liabilities, employees, and unexpended balances of appropriations, allocations, and other funds... are hereby transferred to the Corporation","parent_excerpt":"There shall be transferred to the Small Business Administration the records, property, and unexpended balances of appropriations and other funds","explanation":"This is a close, concrete transfer formula covering the same core administrative assets and funds."},{"child_excerpt":"shall be subject to direction and control by the Secretary of the Treasury","parent_excerpt":"subject to his direction and control, by such officers and employees... as he shall designate","explanation":"Both pair the transfer with an express direction-and-control provision governing administration."},{"child_excerpt":"This order shall become effective on September 24, 1956.","parent_excerpt":"This order shall become effective at the close of business on November 30, 1953.","explanation":"Both close the same compact transfer-and-liquidation structure with a specified effective date."}]}
